What is the definition of the SI unit for a force?

  1. The force required to accelerate, in the direction of the force, a mass of 1 kg at 1 m s−2
  2. The force required to accelerate, in the direction of the force, a mass at 1 m s−2
  3. The weight of a mass of 0.1 kg
  4. The change in momentum per second
